description: Deliberate exceptions to the core-is-the-only-implementation rule. Each entry must name the file, the rule, and (optionally) the enclosing function, and must give a reason and a tracking note. check-sdk-divergence.mjs fails when an entry matches nothing, so fixed items must be removed here.

entries.reason: Ed25519 keygen for evidence-bundle signing. Verification and key parsing now run in the core (evidence.ed25519_verify, evidence.ed25519_public_key); keygen and signing are still Go-side because the core has no signing op and the claim bytes must match Go json.Marshal.
entries.tracking: owner decision: add ed25519 keygen and sign ops to core/src/evidence.rs (verify already moved)

entries.reason: Content hash labelled sha256:<hex> for evidence artifacts. A pure hash, not yet a core op; it is small and can move with the evidence module.
entries.tracking: to move: add evidence.sha256_hex to core/src/evidence.rs and bind it

entries.reason: Session file name is SHA-256(dveID NUL sessionID) in the shared FileStore layout, which is a storage contract with the server.
entries.tracking: to move: core path-digest op, or document the layout as a Go-only reader

entries.reason: CertificateHash is SHA-256 of the marshalled report body. The report is built in Go, so the hash is computed beside it.
Integrity check of knirv_core.wasm against the stamped digest, run before the core can be loaded. It cannot be delegated to the core it guards.
Self-check fingerprint of secret groups, excluding transport paths. Used only to compare providers.
entries.tracking: to move: secrets.group_fingerprint op in core/src/secrets.rs

entries.reason: WebCrypto SHA-256 check of crypto-core.wasm against the manifest digest before the module is instantiated. Mirrors the Go loader's trust-root check.
RESOURCE_TYPES and QUERY_KEYS are literal-typed mirrors of core/src/uri.rs, kept for compile-time types. uri.test.ts asserts they equal the core's lists.
entries.tracking: to move: derive the types from a core uri.registry call if the literal union can be generated
